provenance.verification_note: Legacy gap-check vocabulary retained for compatibility pending phase-3 generation.

records.label: Written safety manual or programme
records.action: Have the written manual to hand as a single PDF.

records.label: Hazard communication programme
records.action: Check it names who keeps the safety data sheets and where.

records.label: Lockout/tagout programme
records.action: Check it covers the equipment your crew actually isolates.

records.label: Confined space entry programme
records.action: Only relevant if your crew enters confined spaces; confirm that first.

records.label: Fall protection programme
records.action: Check it covers the heights and anchor points on your jobs.

records.label: Respiratory protection programme
records.action: Fit-test records are commonly requested alongside this; confirm against the client list.

records.label: Personal protective equipment programme
records.action: Check it includes the written hazard assessment, not just a kit list.

records.label: Emergency action plan
records.action: Check whether the client expects site-specific detail.

records.label: Drug and alcohol policy
records.action: Ask the hiring client which testing standard applies.

records.label: Certificate of insurance
records.action: Compare the limits and named insured with the client's own requirement.

records.label: OSHA 300 / 300A logs
records.action: Confirm the required years and signature expectations against the client list.
